rows.jyutping: m4 gu3 jan4 gam2 sau6 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something without regard for other people’s feelings.

example.english: They insensitively called someone's report rubbish in front of all their colleagues.
example.traditional: 佢唔顧人感受咁，當住成班同事面話人哋份報告垃圾。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 gu3 jan4 gam2 sau6 gam3 dong1 zyu6 sing4 baan1 tung4 si6 min6 waa6 jan4 dei6 fan6 bou3 gou3 laap6 saap3

rows.note: Use this when the insensitive behavior specifically shows a lack of empathy.

example.english: Don't insensitively ask someone who just lost their job why they are not looking for work.
example.traditional: 你唔好冇同理心咁問個啱啱失業嘅人點解唔搵工。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 mou5 tung4 lei5 sam1 gam3 man6 go3 ngaam1 ngaam1 sat1 jip6 ge3 jan4 dim2 gaai2 m4 wan2 gung1

rows.note: Use this for behavior that comes across as especially cold, heartless, or lacking human warmth.

example.english: The company insensitively fired an employee who was ill.
example.traditional: 間公司冇人情味咁，炒咗個病緊嘅員工。
example.jyutping: gaan3 gung1 si1 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6 gam3 caau2 zo2 go3 beng6 gan2 ge3 jyun4 gung1
